---
name: Bug report
about: Something does not behave as documented
labels: bug
---

> **Security issues** (a user can read data their policy does not grant, a bypass, a leak): do not file
> an issue. Use the private reporting channel in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).

**What happened / what you expected**

**Reproduction** (policy objects, request, backend and version; redact tokens and data)

**Decision reason and trace ID** (`error` body fields `errorType`, `traceId`; see docs/troubleshooting.md)

**Versions** (Querdian, Prometheus/Loki/Tempo, Kubernetes)
